name: SecretHunt
short: WoW-style secret hunts: hidden, personalised puzzles in forum posts, a Hall of Secrets, and badge roles for harder tiers.
description: Secrets of Wonderland. Each puzzle starts from a public poem that hides a word (spelled by its first letters, or the answer to its riddle). Saying the word starts a personal chain (every member gets their own variant, picked by a private salted hash): a riddle by DM, a pinned object to react to or press a button on in the right forum post or channel, a morning-after clue (a jumbled word or an emoji rebus), and an answer sent back in DMs. Solvers are listed on the Hall of Secrets, one post per puzzle. Easy puzzles give no role; Medium, Hard and Expert each have their own role (with an icon on boosted servers). New puzzles are added as data and old ones never expire.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per member, how far they have got in each hunt puzzle (stage, timestamps, their variant, wrong-guess counts) and, per puzzle, the ordered list of user IDs who solved it. The Hall of Secrets shows solvers' display names. It is deleted on a Red data-deletion request.
install_msg: Run `.secrethunt` to open the control panel: pick 2 to 5 hiding places (Hunt tab), set the Hall, set up and start the puzzle (Puzzles tab), set tier roles (Roles tab), then turn the hunt on. Try it first with Test mode. Easy has no role. Confirm the deploy with `.secrethunt version`.
